RegistrationInfo.Author: daniel
RegistrationInfo.Description: Resync the WSL2 VM clock (hwclock -s) after the host resumes from sleep/hibernate. WSL2's clock freezes during suspend and does not auto-resync (microsoft/WSL#5324), which breaks TLS cert validity windows and JWT expiry. Fires on Kernel-Power event 107 (resume); only acts if the WSL VM (vmmemWSL/vmmem) is already running, so it never spins WSL up just to sync. Relevant here because the machine auto-hibernates after 30 min idle.

Exec.Arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "if (Get-Process vmmemWSL,vmmem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { wsl.exe -u root hwclock -s }"
